decision.reason: [ev-3f8015970328] is a single CLI changelog line that only says "Remove credentials sync manifests" and links to PR #5347. It does not say which manifests these are (repo examples, install output or generated resources), what kinds or names they have, or how an environment would contain them. It also does not say what happens to an environment that used them or whether anything replaces them. To write the subject, applicability and consequence we need the PR content or a matching upgrade/docs note.
